items.source: Defines the class implementing the PropertyValueConverter interface.
items.translation: 定义实现 PropertyValueConverter 接口的类。

items.source: Defines the class implementing the PropertyValueConverter interface. If this is a normal class, it must provide a default constructor with no arguments. If this is an enum and thus implementing a singleton by enum it must only have one enum value.
items.translation: 定义实现 PropertyValueConverter 接口的类。如果这是一个普通类，则必须提供一个无参数的默认构造函数。如果这是一个枚举（即通过枚举实现单例），则只能包含一个枚举值。

items.source:
Annotation to put on a property of an entity to define a value converter which can convert the property to a type
that Elasticsearch understands and back.
items.translation: 在实体属性上添加的注解，用于定义一个值转换器，该转换器可将属性转换为 Elasticsearch 可识别的类型，并支持反向转换。

items.source: the class to use for conversion
